get.description: This endpoint serves as a cache for user-defined metadata of the export for the front end UI to retrieve it, if one was created using the POST ../export/visual endpoint. The metadata structure is not verified.

get.description: Returns 202 until original POST export request is not processed.Returns 200 with exported data once the export is done.

202.description: Request is accepted, provided exportId exists, but export is not yet ready.

get.description: After clients creates a POST export request, the processing of it will start shortly asynchronously. To retrieve the result, client has to check periodically for the result on this endpoint. In case the result isn't ready yet, the service returns 202. If the result is ready, it returns 200 and octet stream of the result file with provided filename.

attributes.description: Attributes to be used in the computation.

auxMeasures.description: Metrics to be referenced from other AFM objects (e.g. filters) but not included in the result.

filters.description: Various filter types to filter the execution result.

measureDefinitionOverrides.description: (EXPERIMENTAL) Override definitions of catalog metrics for this request. Allows substituting a catalog metric's MAQL definition without modifying the stored definition.

parameters.description: (EXPERIMENTAL) Parameter values to use for this execution.

AFM.description: Top level executable entity. Combination of [A]ttributes, [F]ilters & [M]etrics.

emptyValueHandling.description: Specifies how rows with empty (null/missing) date values should be handled. INCLUDE includes empty dates in addition to the date range restriction, EXCLUDE removes rows with empty dates (default), ONLY keeps only rows with empty dates.

AbsoluteDateFilter.description: A datetime filter specifying exact from and to values.

emptyValueHandling.description: Specifies how rows with empty (null/missing) date values should be handled. INCLUDE includes empty dates in addition to the date range restriction, EXCLUDE removes rows with empty dates (default), ONLY keeps only rows with empty dates.

from.description: Start of the range (including), in the format matching 'granularity'. If omitted, the range is unbounded at the start.

granularity.description: Granularity determining the filtered date attribute and the expected 'from'/'to' format.

to.description: End of the range (including), in the format matching 'granularity'. If omitted, the range is unbounded at the end.

AbsoluteGranularityDateFilter.description: An absolute date range filter defined at a specific granularity. The 'from'/'to' literals must match the format of the chosen granularity (e.g. '2020' for YEAR, '2012-05' for MONTH, '2012-3' for QUARTER, '1996-01' for WEEK, '2010-10-30' for DAY, or a plain ordinal like '6' for periodical granularities such as MONTH_OF_YEAR). At least one of 'from'/'to' must be provided; specifying only one yields an open-ended range.

AfmIdentifier.description: Reference to the attribute label to which the filter should be applied.

AfmObjectIdentifier.description: ObjectIdentifier with `identifier` wrapper. This serves to distinguish MD object identifiers in AFM request from local identifiers.

AfmObjectIdentifierAttribute.description: Reference to the date attribute to use.

AfmObjectIdentifierCore.description: Reference to the metric, fact or attribute object to use for the metric.

AfmObjectIdentifierDataset.description: Reference to the date dataset to which the filter should be applied.

emptyValueHandling.description: Specifies how rows with empty (null/missing) date values should be handled. INCLUDE means no filtering effect (default), EXCLUDE removes rows with null dates, ONLY keeps only rows with null dates.

granularity.description: Date granularity used to resolve the date attribute label for null value checks. Defaults to DAY if not specified.

AllTimeDateFilter.description: An all-time date filter that does not restrict by date range. Controls how rows with empty (null/missing) date values are handled.

measureIdentifiers.description: List of metrics to apply arithmetic operation by chosen operator.

operator.description: Arithmetic operator describing operation between metrics.

ArithmeticMeasureDefinition.description: Metric representing arithmetics between other metrics.

uris.description: List of attribute elements by reference

values.description: List of attribute elements by value

AttributeFilterElements.description: Filter on specific set of label values.

localIdentifier.description: Local identifier of the attribute. This can be used to reference the attribute in other parts of the execution definition.

showAllValues.description: Indicates whether to show all values of given attribute even if the data bound to those values is not available.

from.description: Start of the filtering interval. Specified by number of periods (with respect to given granularity). Typically negative (historical time interval like -2 for '2 days/weeks, ... ago'). If null, then start of the range is unbounded.

granularity.description: Date granularity specifying particular date attribute in given dimension.

to.description: End of the filtering interval. Specified by number of periods (with respect to given granularity). Value 'O' is representing current time-interval (current day, week, ...). If null, then end of the range is unbounded.

BoundedFilter.description: Bounding filter for this relative date filter. This can be used to limit the range of the relative date filter to a specific date range.

ComparisonCondition.description: Condition that compares the metric value to a given constant value using a comparison operator.

dimensionality.description: References to the attributes to be used when filtering.

treatNullValuesAs.description: A value that will be substituted for null values in the metric for the comparisons.

ComparisonMeasureValueFilter.description: Filter the result by comparing specified metric to given constant value, using given comparison operator.

conditions.description: List of conditions to apply. Conditions are combined with OR logic. Each condition can be either a comparison (e.g., > 100) or a range (e.g., BETWEEN 10 AND 50). If empty, no filtering is applied and all rows are returned.

dimensionality.description: References to the attributes to be used when filtering.

treatNullValuesAs.description: A value that will be substituted for null values in the metric for the comparisons.

CompoundMeasureValueFilter.description: Filter the result by applying multiple comparison and/or range conditions combined with OR logic. If conditions list is empty, no filtering is applied (all rows are returned).

enabled.description: Whether the rules are applied when rendering.

rules.description: Rules evaluated in order; within a target, the first matching condition wins.

ConditionalFormatting.description: Conditional formatting for a table, with one entry per formatted column.

from.description: `YYYY-MM-DD`, or `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm` at hour or minute granularity.

to.description: `YYYY-MM-DD`, or `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm` at hour or minute granularity. Inclusive.

ConditionalFormattingAttributeTarget.description: An attribute column, addressed by its bucket item local identifier.

operator.description: How a condition compares the cell value against its value.

ConditionalFormattingCondition.description: A condition and the formatting applied to cells matching it.

backgroundColor.description: Background color as a hex triplet.

color.description: Text color as a hex triplet.

scope.description: Whether the formatting applies to the matching cell only, or to its whole row.

ConditionalFormattingFormat.description: Visual formatting applied to a matching cell.

ConditionalFormattingLiteral.description: A string or a number, serialized in whichever form it was authored.

ConditionalFormattingLiteralValue.description: A single value compared against the cell value.

ConditionalFormattingMeasureTarget.description: A measure column, addressed by its bucket item local identifier.

ConditionalFormattingNoneValue.description: No value; used by operators that take none.

ConditionalFormattingRelativeDateValue.description: A date period relative to the moment of evaluation, resolved at render time.

from.description: Offset in periods; 0 is the current period, negative is the past.

granularity.description: Granularity the offsets are counted in.

to.description: Offset in periods, not lower than `from`.

conditions.description: Conditions evaluated in order; the first match wins.

ConditionalFormattingRule.description: Conditions applied to a single column.

ConditionalFormattingTarget.description: Column a rule formats. The shape is selected by the `kind` property.

ConditionalFormattingValue.description: Value a condition compares against. The shape is selected by the `kind` property.

labels.description: Map of CustomLabels with keys used as placeholders in document.

metrics.description: Map of CustomMetrics with keys used as placeholders in document.

CustomOverride.description: Custom cell value overrides (IDs will be replaced with specified values).

exportInfo.description: If true, the export will contain the information about the export – exported date, dashboard filters, etc.

mergeHeaders.description: Merge equal headers in neighbouring cells. Used for [XLSX] format only.

dashboardFiltersOverride.description: List of filters that will be used instead of the default dashboard filters.

dashboardParametersOverride.description: Parameter value overrides applied to the export's executions. Each entry carries the parameter id (used as an AFM execution override) plus the FE-supplied title for the info sheet. Applied uniformly across all tabs; use dashboardTabsParametersOverrides for tab-scoped overrides.

dashboardTabsFiltersOverrides.description: Map of tab-specific filter overrides. Key is tabId, value is list of filters for that tab.

dashboardTabsParametersOverrides.description: Map of tab-specific parameter overrides. Key is tabId, value is a list of (id, value, title) entries that override the dashboard-level parameters for that tab only. Mirrors dashboardTabsFiltersOverrides. When a tab is present in this map, its entries take precedence over dashboardParametersOverride for that tab's executions and info-sheet display.

fileName.description: Filename of downloaded file without extension.

widgetIds.description: List of widget identifiers to be exported. Note that only one widget is currently supported.

DashboardTabularExportRequest.description: Export request object describing the export properties for dashboard tabular exports.

DateFilter.description: Abstract filter definition type for dates.

dataSamplingPercentage.description: Specifies the percentage of rows from fact datasets to use during computation. This feature is available only for workspaces that use a Vertica Data Source without table views.

timestamp.description: Specifies the timestamp of the execution from which relative filters are resolved. If not set, the current time is used.

timezone.description: Specifies the time zone used to resolve relative date filters and to convert time-zone-aware date/time values in the result. Expects an IANA time zone id (e.g. "Europe/Prague") or a fixed GMT offset (e.g. "GMT+02:00"). If not set, the time zone from the workspace/user settings is used.

ExecutionSettings.description: Various settings affecting the process of AFM execution or its result

FilterDefinitionForSimpleMeasure.description: Abstract filter definition type for simple metric.

fileName.description: File name to be used for retrieving the image document.

timezoneId.description: Time zone the export should be rendered in, as an IANA identifier (e.g. 'Asia/Kolkata') or a GMT offset (e.g. 'GMT+01:00'). When omitted, the workspace time zone setting is used.

widgetIds.description: List of widget identifiers to be exported. Note that only one widget is currently supported.

ImageExportRequest.description: Export request object describing the export properties and metadata for image exports.

InlineFilterDefinition.description: Filter in form of direct MAQL query.

InlineMeasureDefinition.description: Metric defined by the raw MAQL query.

JsonNode.description: Metadata definition in free-form JSON format.

caseSensitive.description: Indicates whether the filter match is evaluated in case-sensitive mode or not.

literal.description: Literal used to limit label values.

negate.description: Indicates whether the filter should negate the match.

MatchAttributeFilter.description: Filter via label with given match type and literal value.

localIdentifier.description: Local identifier of the metric. This can be used to reference the metric in other parts of the execution definition.

MeasureItem.description: Metric is a quantity that is calculated from the data.

MeasureValueCondition.description: A condition for filtering by measure value. Can be either a comparison or a range condition.

MeasureValueFilter.description: Abstract filter definition type filtering by the value of the metric.

MetricDefinitionOverride.description: (EXPERIMENTAL) Override for a catalog metric definition.

usesArbitraryValues.description: If true, indicates that the values in notInElements were filled free-form, otherwise they have been picked from existing elements.

NegativeAttributeFilter.description: Filter able to limit element values by label and related selected negated elements.

value.description: Value to use for this parameter instead of its default.

id.description: Identifier of the workspace parameter (matches the parameter entity id).

title.description: Display title of the parameter as the client wants it rendered on the info sheet.

value.description: Value to use for this parameter when executing the export.

ParameterValue.description: Parameter value override applied to the export. The (id, value) pair drives the execution; the title is FE-supplied for info-sheet display.

selector.description: CSS selector where to apply given properties.

PdfTableStyle.description: Custom CSS styles for the table. (PDF, HTML)

periodsAgo.description: Number of periods ago to calculate the previous period for.

PopDataset.description: Combination of the date data set to use and how many periods ago to calculate the previous period for.

dateDatasets.description: Specification of which date data sets to use for determining the period to calculate the previous period for.

periodsAgo.description: Number of periods ago to calculate the previous period for.

PopDate.description: Combination of the date attribute to use and how many periods ago to calculate the PoP for.

dateAttributes.description: Attributes to use for determining the period to calculate the PoP for.

PopDateMeasureDefinition.description: Period over period type of metric.

usesArbitraryValues.description: If true, indicates that the values in inElements were filled free-form, otherwise they have been picked from existing elements.

PositiveAttributeFilter.description: Filter able to limit element values by label and related selected elements.

RangeCondition.description: Condition that checks if the metric value is within a given range.

dimensionality.description: References to the attributes to be used when filtering.

treatNullValuesAs.description: A value that will be substituted for null values in the metric for the comparisons.

RangeMeasureValueFilter.description: Filter the result by comparing specified metric to given range of values.

dimensionality.description: References to the attributes to be used when filtering.

measures.description: References to the metrics to be used when filtering.

operator.description: The type of ranking to use, TOP or BOTTOM.

strictLimitOfRows.description: When true, filter returns requested number of rows at most. Default is false.

value.description: Number of top/bottom values to filter.

RankingFilter.description: Filter the result on top/bottom N values according to given metric(s).

labels.description: Map of CustomLabels with keys used as placeholders in export result.

metrics.description: Map of CustomMetrics with keys used as placeholders in export result.

RawCustomOverride.description: Custom cell value overrides (IDs will be replaced with specified values).

fileName.description: Filename of downloaded file without extension.

RawExportRequest.description: Export request object describing the export properties and overrides for raw exports.

emptyValueHandling.description: Specifies how rows with empty (null/missing) date values should be handled. INCLUDE includes empty dates in addition to the date range restriction, EXCLUDE removes rows with empty dates (default), ONLY keeps only rows with empty dates.

from.description: Start of the filtering interval. Specified by number of periods (with respect to given granularity). Typically negative (historical time interval like -2 for '2 days/weeks, ... ago').

granularity.description: Date granularity specifying particular date attribute in given dimension.

to.description: End of the filtering interval. Specified by number of periods (with respect to given granularity). Value 'O' is representing current time-interval (current day, week, ...).

RelativeDateFilter.description: A date filter specifying a time interval that is relative to the current date. For example, last week, next month, and so on. Field dataset is representing qualifier of date dimension. The 'from' and 'to' properties mark the boundaries of the interval. If 'from' is omitted, all values earlier than 'to' are included. If 'to' is omitted, all values later than 'from' are included. It is not allowed to omit both.

exportInfo.description: If true, the export will contain the information about the export – exported date, filters, etc. Works only with `visualizationObject`. (XLSX, PDF)

grandTotalsPosition.description: Grand totals position. Takes precedence over position specified in visualization.

mergeHeaders.description: Merge equal headers in neighbouring cells. (XLSX)

pdfTableStyle.description: Custom CSS styles for the table. (PDF, HTML)

showFilters.description: Print applied filters on top of the document. (PDF/HTML when visualizationObject is given)

aggregation.description: Definition of aggregation type of the metric.

computeRatio.description: If true, compute the percentage of given metric values (broken down by AFM attributes) to the total (not broken down).

filters.description: Metrics can be filtered by attribute filters with the same interface as ones for global AFM. Note that only one DateFilter is allowed.

SimpleMeasureDefinition.description: Metric defined by referencing a MAQL metric or an LDM fact object with aggregation.

fileName.description: File name to be used for retrieving the pdf document.

timezoneId.description: Time zone the export should be rendered in, as an IANA identifier (e.g. 'Asia/Kolkata') or a GMT offset (e.g. 'GMT+01:00'). When omitted, the workspace time zone setting is used.

visualizationIds.description: List of visualization ids to be exported. Note that only one visualization is currently supported.

widgetIds.description: List of widget identifiers to be exported. Note that only one widget is currently supported.

SlidesExportRequest.description: Export request object describing the export properties and metadata for slides exports.

executionResult.description: Execution result identifier for this layer.

title.description: Layer title used for the exported sheet or file name.

TabularExportExecution.description: A single pre-executed layer in a multi-layer tabular export.

executions.description: Pre-executed layers for multi-layer geo visualizations. When provided, this is the canonical source of the exported layers and takes precedence over the top-level executionResult and customOverride, which are ignored. Index 0 is the main layer; each layer carries its own executionResult and customOverride.

fileName.description: Filename of downloaded file without extension.

relatedDashboardId.description: Analytical dashboard identifier. Optional identifier, which informs the system that the export is related to a specific dashboard.

visualizationObject.description: Visualization object identifier. Alternative to executionResult property.

visualizationObjectCustomFilters.description: Optional custom filters (as array of IFilter objects defined in UI SDK) to be applied when visualizationObject is given. Those filters override the original filters defined in the visualization.

visualizationObjectCustomParameters.description: Optional custom parameters to be applied when visualizationObject is given. Those parameters override the original parameters defined in the visualization.

TabularExportRequest.description: Export request object describing the export properties and overrides for tabular exports.

fileName.description: File name to be used for retrieving the pdf document.

metadata.description: Metadata definition in free-form JSON format.

timezoneId.description: Time zone the export should be rendered in, as an IANA identifier (e.g. 'Asia/Kolkata') or a GMT offset (e.g. 'GMT+01:00'). When omitted, the workspace time zone setting is used.

VisualExportRequest.description: Export request object describing the export properties and metadata for dashboard PDF exports.
